title: Weight of a coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $[n]$, and assign a sign in $\{\pm1\}$ to each coordinate outside $J$. The weight of the resulting restriction, which leaves coordinates in $J$ free and fixes the others to their assigned signs, is $\delta^{|J|}\bigl((1-\delta)/2\bigr)^{n-|J|}$.
